                                                ORDINANCE


 BE IT ORDAINED BY THE CITY COUNCIL OF THE CITY OF CHICAGO:

 SECTION 1. Title 17 of the Municipal Code of Chicago, the Chicago Zoning Ordinance, is hereby

 amended by changing all of the RT4 Two-Flat, Townhouse and Multi-Unit District symbols and

 indications as shown on Map No. 1-L in the area bounded by

              The public alley next north of and parallel to West Madison Street; the public alley
              next east of and parallel to North Central Avenue; a line 385 feet north of the north
              line of West Madison Street; North Pine Avenue; West Madison Street, and North
              Central Avenue,

to those of a B3-2 Community Shopping District.

 SECTION 2. This ordinance takes effect after its passage and due publication.



Common Street Address:               1-31 North Central Avenue; 5500-5536 West Madison Street; 2-38
                                     North Pine Street
